data$Gender = factor(data$Gender, levels = c(1,2), labels=c("Female","Male"))

#Tämä on tehty korrelaatiorakenteen perusteella. Poistetaan ne vahvasti keskenään korreloivat muuttujat.
dataAnalysis<- data %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(ID, L_Leg_length, R_Leg_length,Skin_ATmm,Tibia_average))



dataAnalysis <- na.omit(dataAnalysis)

dataAnalysis <- as.data.frame(dataAnalysis)

d = dataAnalysis[-17]
d$Gender <- as.integer(factor(d$Gender))

vars21 <- c("Gender","Age","Height","Weight","BMI","BF","MVC",
            "MG_Area","LG_Area","SOL_Area","AT_Thickness",
            "MG_subtendon_length","LG_subtendon_length","SOL_subtendon_length",
            "Tibia_length_I","Tibia_length_O",
            "AT_moment_arm","Ankle_Cal","Foot_moment_arm",
            "AT_Moment_arm_norm_to_tibia","AT_Moment_arm_norm_to_height")
MLP <- make_Weka_classifier("weka/classifiers/functions/MultilayerPerceptron")

# LDA ja QDA (MASS:: ilman library(MASS), jotta dplyr::select ei peity)




set.seed(42)
models <- list(


    # monitasoinen logistinen regressio pelkällä AT_Thicknessilla

  logit_AT = function(tr, te)
    predict(multinom(Group ~ AT_Thickness, data = tr, trace = FALSE, maxit = 2000), te),

  # kaikki 21 muuttujaa, ridge-rangaistus (tavallinen multinom hajoaa, kun n = 78)
  ridge_kaikki = function(tr, te) {
    x_tr <- as.matrix(tr[, vars21]); m <- colMeans(x_tr); s <- apply(x_tr, 2, sd)
    x_tr <- scale(x_tr, m, s); x_te <- scale(as.matrix(te[, vars21]), m, s)
    cv <- cv.glmnet(x_tr, tr$Group, family = "multinomial", alpha = 0,
                    nfolds = 5, type.measure = "class")
    factor(predict(cv, x_te, s = "lambda.min", type = "class")[, 1], levels = levels(tr$Group))
  },

  rf_tav = function(tr, te)
    predict(randomForest(Group ~ ., data = tr[, c("Group", vars21)], ntree = 2000, mtry = 5), te),
  #
  rf_tas = function(tr, te){
    ss <- min(table(tr$Group))
    predict(randomForest(Group ~ ., data = tr[, c("Group", vars21)], ntree = 2000, mtry = 5,
                         strata = tr$Group, sampsize = rep(ss, 3)), te)},

  rf_AT = function(tr, te)
    predict(randomForest(Group ~ AT_Thickness, data = tr, ntree = 2000, mtry = 1), te),

  rf_eiAT = function(tr, te)
    predict(randomForest(Group ~ ., data = tr[, c("Group", setdiff(vars21, "AT_Thickness"))],
                         ntree = 2000, mtry = 5), te)
)

cv_run <- function(model, rep_id, k = 10) {
  set.seed(rep_id)
  folds <- createFolds(d$Group, k = k)
  pred <- factor(rep(NA, nrow(d)), levels = levels(d$Group))
  for (f in folds) pred[f] <- model(d[-f, ], d[f, ])
  pred
}

metrics <- function(pred, y = d$Group) {
  rec <- diag(table(y, pred)) / as.numeric(table(y))
  c(err = mean(pred != y),
    setNames(1 - rec, paste0("err_", levels(y))),
    bacc = mean(rec))
}


mk_tas <- function(mt) function(tr, te) {
  ss <- min(table(tr$Group))
  predict(randomForest(Group ~ ., data = tr[, c("Group", vars21)], ntree = 2000, mtry = mt,
                       strata = tr$Group, sampsize = rep(ss, 3)), te)
}
models$rf_tas_m10 <- mk_tas(10)
models$rf_tas_m21 <- mk_tas(21)            # Uusioaggregointi

# järjestysasteikollinen malli (terve < tendino < repeämä)
models$ordinal_AT <- function(tr, te) {
  tr2 <- tr; tr2$Group <- factor(tr2$Group, ordered = TRUE)
  p <- predict(MASS::polr(Group ~ AT_Thickness, data = tr2, Hess = TRUE), te, type = "class")
  factor(as.character(p), levels = levels(tr$Group))
}

# riittääkö AT_Thickness vai tuovatko ikä ja Foot_moment_arm lisää
models$logit_AT_Age_F <- function(tr, te){
  predict(multinom(Group ~ AT_Thickness + Age + Foot_moment_arm, data = tr, trace = FALSE, maxit = 2000), te)}


# apufunktio: varmistaa, että ennusteen tasot ovat samat kuin aineiston
as_lv <- function(p, tr) factor(as.character(p), levels = levels(tr$Group))

MLP <- make_Weka_classifier("weka/classifiers/functions/MultilayerPerceptron")

# LDA ja QDA (MASS:: ilman library(MASS), jotta dplyr::select ei peity)
models$lda_AT <- function(tr, te)
  as_lv(predict(MASS::lda(Group ~ AT_Thickness, data = tr), newdata = te)$class, tr)

models$qda_AT <- function(tr, te)
  as_lv(predict(MASS::qda(Group ~ AT_Thickness, data = tr), newdata = te)$class, tr)

# SVM
models$svm_lin_AT <- function(tr, te)
  as_lv(predict(e1071::svm(Group ~ AT_Thickness, data = tr,
                           type = "C-classification", kernel = "linear"),
                newdata = te), tr)

models$svm_pol_AT <- function(tr, te)
  as_lv(predict(e1071::svm(Group ~ AT_Thickness, data = tr,
                           type = "C-classification", kernel = "polynomial"),
                newdata = te), tr)

# Neuroverkot (Weka MLP)
models$mlp_AT <- function(tr, te)
  as_lv(predict(MLP(Group ~ AT_Thickness, data = tr,
                    control = Weka_control(V = 20, S = 1)), newdata = te), tr)


tr <- d[-(1:6), ]; te <- d[1:6, ]

library(randomForest)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# (Oletetaan, että d, vars21, models ja cv_run on jo määritetty skriptissäsi)

# Apufunktio: poimitaan satunnaismetsän OOB-virheet samaan muotoon metrics()-funktion kanssa
oob_metrics <- function(rf, y = d$Group) {
  ntree_val <- nrow(rf$err.rate)
  err_overall <- rf$err.rate[ntree_val, 1]
  class_errs <- rf$err.rate[ntree_val, -1]
  names(class_errs) <- paste0("err_", levels(y))
  bacc <- mean(1 - class_errs)
  c(err = err_overall, class_errs, bacc = bacc)
}

# Lasketaan OOB-metrikat satunnaismetsille täyden aineiston perusteella
# set.seed(1) # Toistettavuuden vuoksi
ss_full <- min(table(d$Group))

oob_list <- list(
  rf_tav      = oob_metrics(randomForest(Group ~ ., data = d[, c("Group", vars21)], ntree = 2000, mtry = 5)),
  rf_tas      = oob_metrics(randomForest(Group ~ ., data = d[, c("Group", vars21)], ntree = 2000, mtry = 5, strata = d$Group, sampsize = rep(ss_full, 3))),
  rf_AT       = oob_metrics(randomForest(Group ~ AT_Thickness, data = d, ntree = 2000, mtry = 1)),
  rf_eiAT     = oob_metrics(randomForest(Group ~ ., data = d[, c("Group", setdiff(vars21, "AT_Thickness"))], ntree = 2000, mtry = 5)),
  rf_tas_m10  = oob_metrics(randomForest(Group ~ ., data = d[, c("Group", vars21)], ntree = 2000, mtry = 10, strata = d$Group, sampsize = rep(ss_full, 3))),
  rf_tas_m21  = oob_metrics(randomForest(Group ~ ., data = d[, c("Group", vars21)], ntree = 2000, mtry = 21, strata = d$Group, sampsize = rep(ss_full, 3)))
)

# Aiemmat ristiinvalidoinnin ajot
n_rep <- 20
res <- lapply(models, function(m) t(sapply(1:n_rep, function(r) metrics(cv_run(m, r)))))
summ <- t(sapply(res, function(x) c(colMeans(x))))
rownames(summ) <- names(models)

# Muunnetaan summ-taulukko merkkijonotaulukoksi, jossa RF-mallien kohdalla on (OOB)
summ_formatted <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(summ), ncol = ncol(summ))
rownames(summ_formatted) <- rownames(summ)
colnames(summ_formatted) <- colnames(summ)

for (i in rownames(summ)) {
  if (i %in% names(oob_list)) {
    cv_vals <- summ[i, ]
    oob_vals <- oob_list[[i]]
    for (j in seq_along(cv_vals)) {
      summ_formatted[i, j] <- sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", cv_vals[j], oob_vals[j])
    }
  } else {
    for (j in seq_along(summ[i, ])) {
      summ_formatted[i, j] <- sprintf("%.3f", summ[i, j])
    }
  }
}


# Muutetaan taulukko data.frameksi ja nostetaan rivinimet omaksi "Malli"-sarakkeekseen
df_print <- as.data.frame(summ_formatted)
df_print <- tibble::rownames_to_column(df_print, var = "Malli")

# Korvataan mallien nimien alaviivat LaTeX-turvallisilla alaviivoilla (\_)
df_print$Malli <- gsub("_", "\\\\_", df_print$Malli)

# Tulostus LaTeX-taulukkona
df_print %>%
  kable(
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    escape = FALSE,
    caption = "Toistetun 10-kertaisen ristiinvalidoinnin tulokset, kun toistojen määrä on 20. Satunnaismetsämalleilla suluissa on esitetty vastaava (laukutus)virhe täydestä aineistosta.",
    col.names = c("Malli", "Virhe", "Terve", "Tendinopatia", "Repeämä", "BACC")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down"),
    position = "left",
    full_width = FALSE
  )
